scripts.check:generated: node scripts/generate-rules.mjs --client c2egf_burkina --check && node scripts/generate-functions-config.mjs --client c2egf_burkina --check
scripts.quality:check: npm run check:generated && npm run check:secrets && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm run lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:components && npm run build
scripts.quality:check:emulators: npm run test:firestore && npm run test:integration && npm run test:functions
scripts.quality:check:full: npm run quality:check && npm run quality:check:emulators
scripts.test:firestore: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-akayis-test "npx vitest run --config vitest.firestore.config.js"
scripts.test:firestore:smoke: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-akayis-test "npx vitest run --config vitest.firestore.config.js tests/firestore/smoke.test.js"
scripts.test:integration: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project demo-akayis-test "npx vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.js"
scripts.test:functions: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-akayis-test "npx vitest run --config vitest.functions.config.js"
scripts.test:functions:e2e: firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-akayis-test "npx vitest run --config vitest.functions-e2e.config.js"
